claims.text: Sarvam Launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian Languages at ₹0.50 a Minute
claims.llm_reason: The article states the API is launched for English and 22 Indian languages at $0.50 per minute.

claims.text: The Bengaluru startup's new developer tool pairs its Saaras v4 speech model with a dictation-tuned Sarvam 105B to turn speech into edited text in one call.
claims.llm_reason: The article describes the pairing of Saaras v4 and Sarvam 105B for speech-to-text conversion.

claims.text: Dictate turns speech into edited, ready-to-send text in English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute of audio
claims.llm_reason: The article confirms Dictate's functionality and pricing structure.

claims.text: In Sarvam's own tests, Dictate needed 40% fewer character edits than Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe on short English dictations
claims.llm_reason: The article reports this specific comparison and percentage from Sarvam's tests.

claims.text: The API accepts up to 1,000 custom names and terms per request and handles live dictation plus recordings of up to an hour
claims.llm_reason: The article states the API's capabilities regarding custom names and dictation length.
